research_question: Does the existing SETUP_01 close > H1 confirmation arrive too late, and can a pre-confirmation rule using only information available at t obtain more Wave3 headroom without introducing a large population of eventual failures or materially worse adverse excursion?

source_contract.construction: Run the existing strict as-of Wave Scenario evaluation for every frozen symbol and retain every primary or alternate WAVE_2_TO_3_CANDIDATE anchor context whose LOW0, H1, and LOW2 Swing identities are confirmed as of the observation. Match existing SETUP_01 CONFIRMED/FAILED events when the current system emitted them; retain contexts that were later screened out or unresolved. Do not start from, filter to, or infer the cohort from the 745 CONFIRMED events.
inclusion: primary or alternate WAVE_2_TO_3_CANDIDATE as of the observation, including contexts later hidden by current primary-scenario selection
origin, H1, and LOW2 are existing confirmed Swing identities with confirmed_index <= t
one cohort row per distinct causal Wave2 anchor context (symbol, LOW0 pivot, H1 pivot, LOW2 pivot); a later context replacement/reselection is retained as a screened-out unresolved row
later CONFIRMED, FAILED/structurally invalidated, never-CONFIRMED, timeout/unresolved, and later-screened candidates are all retained
Wave2 contexts that fail the existing LOW2 < H1 geometry are retained as invalid/screened cohort rows and cannot emit a policy signal or depth-band metric
exclusion: Final OOS or any formal validation set
future Swing/ZigZag labels, final wave labels, future bars, MFE/MAE/outcome fields in signal definition
survivorship, confirmation conditioning, result-based symbol removal, or result-based candidate replacement

fixed_existing_threshold.name: SETUP01_RECOVERY_RATIO
fixed_existing_threshold.role: existing ARMED milestone; not searched or re-estimated

candidate_policies.signal: first causal day with state == CONFIRMED, which requires close > H1
candidate_policies.entry: exact next frozen market-session OPEN after the confirmation day
candidate_policies.selection: one signal per lifecycle; no Decision/RR/target gate is added to this structural timing comparator

candidate_policies.signal: first causal primary/alternate WAVE_2_TO_3 context observation on or after all three Swing anchors are confirmed, before confirmation/invalidation, where close > previous close, close > LOW2, and close <= H1
candidate_policies.entry: exact next frozen market-session OPEN; no same-bar fill and no later-bar substitution
candidate_policies.selection: one first signal per anchor context; previous close is the immediately preceding observed bar for that symbol

candidate_policies.signal: first causal primary/alternate WAVE_2_TO_3 context observation before confirmation/invalidation where close >= LOW2 + 0.5 * (H1 - LOW2) and close <= H1
candidate_policies.entry: exact next frozen market-session OPEN; no same-bar fill and no later-bar substitution
candidate_policies.selection: one first signal per anchor context; threshold is the existing fixed SETUP_01 ARMED milestone

candidate_policies.signal: first causal primary/alternate WAVE_2_TO_3 context observation before confirmation/invalidation where high >= H1 and close <= H1
candidate_policies.entry: exact next frozen market-session OPEN; no same-bar fill and no later-bar substitution
candidate_policies.selection: one first signal per anchor context; intraday high is known at that day's close and is not the confirmation rule

candidate_policies.signal: first causal ARMED_HALF_RECOVERY day with existing as-of daily_state == UPTREND and weekly_state != DOWNTREND
candidate_policies.entry: exact next frozen market-session OPEN; no same-bar fill and no later-bar substitution
candidate_policies.selection: one first signal per anchor context; regime is existing Wave context, not a newly fitted filter

execution_and_evaluation.signal_information: Only Quote data and existing causal replay/Wave/Swing state with data <= signal_date
execution_and_evaluation.actual_executable_next_session: The exact next date in the frozen market-session union must have a unique finite OPEN for the symbol; otherwise the signal is not executable and is censored for entry metrics
execution_and_evaluation.confirmation_latency_saved: frozen market-session distance from the early signal date to the later CONFIRMED date; only defined for later-CONFIRMED lifecycles
execution_and_evaluation.adverse_excursion: for pre-confirmation policies, minimum observed low from the executable entry session through the first confirmation, close-based structural invalidation, screened-out replacement boundary, or dataset end; for the incumbent, confirmation is already before entry, so continue from its next-session OPEN through the first later structural invalidation or dataset end; report signed and positive adverse magnitude normalized by R
execution_and_evaluation.structural_invalidation: existing causal close <= LOW2 or close <= LOW0 semantics; no execution Stop is defined or selected by this protocol
execution_and_evaluation.common_hurdles: H1 + 0.272R and H1 + 0.618R, evaluated after the executable entry through the first structural invalidation or dataset end; later-CONFIRMED paths continue beyond confirmation, failed paths stop at failure, and never-CONFIRMED screened/timeout paths are censored at their boundary; same-bar hurdle/invalidation ordering is AMBIGUOUS
execution_and_evaluation.outcome_use: All confirmation, failure, adverse-excursion, hurdle, and headroom results are post-definition research evaluation only and never feed back into signal selection

required_reporting: total cohort and policy-signal candidate counts
eventually confirmed, never confirmed, failed, screened-out, timeout/unresolved composition
actual executable next-session entry count and missing-next-session count
entry-to-H1, entry-to-Fib1.272, and entry-to-Fib1.618 remaining headroom over R
adverse excursion until resolution, confirmation latency saved, common hurdle success

robustness.time_split: Within each market, split by the midpoint of the frozen market-session ordinal using candidate ready date, fixed before outcome analysis
robustness.symbol_concentration: Within each policy, identify the count-leading symbol by signal count only, then repeat metrics after removing that symbol

selection_order: first determine whether an earlier signal adds headroom while retaining a broad, non-survivorship cohort and without a large eventual-failure/invalidation population
only if that structural question supports continuation may a separate execution/cost research protocol be proposed
do not use P&L, win rate, expectancy, or broker outcomes as the first-layer selection criterion
forbidden: modifying confirmation, target semantics, 5% gate, 2R, Stop, Wave, Swing, or Fib
broker, state write, or Sheets mutation

outputs.event_detail: compact aggregate only; no raw bars or private holdings
